blocks.text: Will DePue, a former OpenAI researcher who leads the nonprofit research group Unemployment Labs, analyzed the weights—the unique structure—of large language models released openly by DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group. The weights still reflect the configurations of the chips used to train them, and DePue was able to find compelling evidence that the most closely watched models, including Moonshot’s Kimi’s K3 releases and DeepSeek’s V4 models, bear fingerprints from training on Blackwell chips.
